Trump announces Montana 'super range' for advanced weapons testing

Former U.S. President Donald Trump announced plans for a new "super range" to be built in Montana. This facility will be used by the Defense Department to test hypersonic weapons, autonomous systems, and space technology. The announcement was made by Trump.
